title: Marcker's General Electric experiment testing for spacetime torsion

tellings.quote: he did an experiment that was specifically designed to test whether torsion existed in space time and it was a wellth out apparatus very welld designed they did it at General Electric

plain: A scientist named Marcker is said to have run an experiment at General Electric, the large American engineering company, built to test whether spacetime, the combined fabric of space and time, has torsion, a kind of built-in twist. A researcher named Eric W. Davis brings it up on the podcast without naming a source and praises the setup as "very well designed". He tells it because a real test of torsion would bear on whether such exotic physics can be checked in a lab.
